citations.assessment: Sanhedrin lists Marta among Abba bar Aḥa’s sons and before Ḥiyya. Yuhasin’s gloss gives its own inference from the order.
The earlier entry presents both readings of the name and says that the teaching in R. Yehoshua’s name suggests a man.
The internal entry expressly names Ila as Shmuel bar Marta’s son.
The Bavli spells out Rabbah bar bar Ḥana at the head of this chain.
The Bavli spells out Rabbah bar bar Ḥana and reads Shmuel. The parenthetical Rav remains the gloss’s proposed reading.
